summary: 64-year-old took a 60-foot tumbling fall on the Ledges on the Keyhole Route of Longs Peak; bystander care; Colorado Air National Guard hoist; RMRG assisted; Flight for Life to MCR.
location: The Ledges, Keyhole Route, Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. Run-585 merge: NPS Aug-13-2023 release (parent-opened) corroborates — 64-yo College Station male, ~60-ft tumbling fall above the Ledges on the Keyhole Route late Friday Aug 11, CANG hoist with RMRG assist, flown to Medical Center of the Rockies.
